svg.title: French Departments
svg.desc: data.gouv.fr / Etalab, Contours administratifs 2026, derived from IGN Admin Express; 100 m generalization. ODbL 1.0 — https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/. Department selection, Gironde estuary water subtraction using BD TOPAGE, projection, overseas inset placement, coordinate rounding, shared-border topology, SVG and thumbnail conversion. The archived sources and offline generator accompany these derived assets. Hydrography: IGN / OFB, BD TOPAGE, distributed by Sandre / Eaufrance. Licence Ouverte 2.0 — https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/. Preview geometry simplified.
